svg.title: Logged five-star hazard against the archetype
svg.desc: Hazard by pull number for logged character banners before and after version 5.0, with the archetype preset drawn dashed.
svg.text: Five-star chance per pull in logged Genshin Impact character banners, against the tool's archetype
chance of a five-star on that pull
Soft pity and hard pity (pulls 70 to 90)
chance of a five-star on that pull
Gap between logged and archetype hazard (percentage points)
pulls 1 to 83: within about one point
Bands are 95% Wilson intervals. 5.0 and later: 7,657,036 logged five-stars, 37 banners. Before 5.0: 19,262,320, 61 banners.
Source: paimon.moe public tallies, retrieved 2026-10-08. Community data, not the publisher's odds.
Pulls 85 to 89 hold 0.25% of the five-stars logged in 5.0 and later.
